name: OpenGL 3D Vision Wrapper
summary: An OpenGL wrapper that enables Dual-View Rendering (3D Vision) for OpenGL games on Windows. Injects stereo rendering into the OpenGL pipeline via Nvidia's DirectX-OpenGL interop. The old version is open source; the maintained version is closed source. Supports games like DOOM (2016), Wolfenstein: The New Order, Quake 2, KOTOR 1 & 2, and other OpenGL titles.
compatibility_notes: Requires Nvidia GPU with 3D Vision driver support. The latest closed-source version is distributed via 3dsurroundgaming.com alongside game-specific fix configs. Largely replaces the need for HelixMod on OpenGL games.
